task: X2 vocabulary + active discovery on fb/a-core, three videos (ME340 165-195 s, Sam's Club 337-367 s, Walmart 190-220 s: data/clips/*/source-full.mp4 of the phase2 notes, the bench's MP4s)

how_measured.hardware: Modal 1 container, 2 x A100-SXM4-80GB (every run), MPS on, 32 CPU, 160 GiB; no third GPU
how_measured.analysis_time: container clock (perf_counter) from the first discovery stage to the last expansion lift, run after the core's run() on its kept state (SAM 3 vision features of the object keyframes, vocabulary masks, DA3 depth/poses); + shared prep (SAM 3 wall/ceiling/subtitle, ~1-2 s) + write (JSON to the layers Volume + commit). Models loaded and warmed before: cold start excluded. Judge, contact sheets and the recall eval run after the timed part and are not counted.
how_measured.gpu_memory: stubs.Vram: whole-device used memory (torch.cuda.mem_get_info, every process incl. vLLM), sampled every 50 ms; per stage per GPU = max over the stage window; GB = 1e9 bytes (a card = 85.1 GB); flag when > 90%
how_measured.recall_paired_keyframes: in container: every delivered named object (names.json clear/partial, the harness's recall_inputs over ALL delivered mask frames of the reference shot) on a delivered mask frame within 1 frame of one of our object keyframes; found = one of our masks with IoU >= 0.5 at 280x378 (our DA3 grid, 4:3 crop x 160-1120); word match = fast_report_eval.same_name(mask's word or name, delivered category)
how_measured.harness_objects_2d: fast_report_eval.sam3_eval (its GPU job, its 56 delivered frames, its rules) for the run's vocabulary vs vocabulary + a design's new words (expansion effect alone), run 003
how_measured.objects_3d: fast_report_eval.objects3d_row: our object centroids (estimated metres) Sim3-aligned to DROID on the reference shot vs the delivered object map, recall within 0.3 / 0.5 m
how_measured.judge: Qwen3-VL-8B (the same model that names) on each found object's outlined best-view crop: A whole object, B part of a larger object, C surface/background/hole/overlay, D several or none
how_measured.own_look: my own classification (same letters) of the contact-sheet tiles (JPGs in each run folder); where a design found more than 48 objects, a seeded random sample of 48
how_measured.names: every name is model output (unverified); every size/height is estimated (floor plane + assumed 1.6 m camera height)

list_price_upper_by_run.004: ~0.8 (crashed after ME340 on a sheet filename; no meta.json; estimate: ~6 min x 0.00216 $/s)
list_price_upper_by_run.harness_2d_on_003: ~0.3 (3 A100 SAM 3 containers, 72-126 s function wall each)

modal_billing_settled_so_far.note: modal billing report, hours settle late: runs 001-003 partly, 004/005/harness not yet listed

headline.best_design: amg16:vlm = SAM 2.1 automatic masks at 16x16 points on every object keyframe (~1.7 fps), both GPUs -> drop people / big surface pieces / tiny / huge -> lift (E7) with a SigLIP gate -> a cluster is new when most of its views have no vocabulary mask at IoU >= 0.5 -> named by the label cache or Qwen3-VL only (no zero-shot) -> new words -> ONE SAM 3 pass of those words over all object keyframes (kept features)

recall_gain_paired_keyframes.me340: 83 -> 85 of 94 delivered named objects (88.3% -> 90.4%), runs 003 and 004 identical

headline.where_the_gain_comes_from: the new WORDS, not the discovered masks: vocabulary + discovered views alone 83/100/86, vocabulary + expansion masks alone 85/106/92 (run 003)

added_analysis_time_s_2xA100.me340: 19.1 (004, AMG warmed) / 26.6 (003, first AMG call incl. ~8 s warm-up)

headline.gpu_peak_gb_of_85: <= 71.4 GB on either GPU in every run (84%); no stage over 90%
headline.rounds: always 1 productive round + 1 check round (<= 0.05 s): the proposals are fixed and new words only cover more

precision_own_look.samsclub-a2 (amg16, 002): 48 of 49: A 28, B 3, D 17 (bands across a pallet layer)

headline.ehs_finds: weak in these videos: amg16 found no genuine loose cable; SAM 3 generic words found the one real hanging power cord on ME340 (runs 001/002); AMG-32 found 3 genuine floor items on Walmart (a board, a sheet, a plank; wrongly named); stacked goods on Sam's Club are found (bands of a pallet layer) but as parts/groups
naming_hazards: SigLIP zero-shot over the vocabulary named 22 slippers/sign letters 'spill' on Walmart (run 002): EHS false alarms; ':vlm' removes them

Qwen3-VL named red-outlined crops 'fire extinguisher' 1-6 times per video (all wrong in every crop I looked at); rule: a VLM name that is a word SAM 3 already ran on those frames without finding the region is 'detector-vetoed' (kept as an object, never as that EHS item)

rejected_designs.vlm-ground: Qwen3-VL listing boxes on 16 keyframes: 29-52 s (24000 tokens, every answer hit the 1500-token cap), 0 recall gain on all three videos
rejected_designs.sam3-generic: 2-4 s, precise (6 of 7 real) but finds almost nothing new (+0/+0/+1): the catch-all words see what the vocabulary sees
rejected_designs.amg (32x32): +1 to +2 delivered objects over amg16 for 2.2-3x the proposal time (21-33 s vs 7-12 s)
rejected_designs.amg:part: drops parts of known objects but, in stores, also whole packs inside 'pallet' masks: -1..-4 recall
rejected_designs.amg16/2, amg16/3 (AMG on every 2nd/3rd o: 9-11 s / 5-9 s but the gain collapses to +0..+5 / +0..+4: fewer clusters reach 2 views

headline.recommendation: Fast path: amg16:vlm with the detector veto, its new words run as a third SAM 3 vocabulary wave (masks join the core's dedupe/lift/vote like wave 2); do not publish expansion instances as a separate 'new objects' list (in stores 81-83% are printed labels on packs). ~18-21 s on the 2 A100s after the core's objects exist (measured sequential; overlapping it with outlines/cascade is not measured). Optional: SAM 3 catch-all words (+2-4 s) for thin items such as cords.
